description: Upcoming tech meetups in Israel, soonest first. In-person by default; mode=online for online sessions. Use when=week for "what's on this week".

exclude_paid.description: Leave out meetups known to cost money. Most meetups are free.

mode.description: in-person (default, the site's main list), online (Israeli online sessions, the site's «אונליין» tab) or any.

when.description: Time window in Asia/Jerusalem: today, tomorrow, week (today + 6 days) or all upcoming.

name: list_upcoming_meetups
title: List upcoming meetups
